title: and it was not easy for him
text: and it was not easy for him. These work okay...once you can get them apart to fill them.  As a senior citizen, there should be a warning that they do not screw apart but must be PULLED apart. They fit VERY TIGHT!!!  I had to get my son to do it...and it was not easy for him, either.  I dread having to refill them.  If I had not thrown away the box I would have returned them.  So for now, they work to grind my pink Himalayan salt, that I wanted to add to my families diet.  They work well...but the way they are filled is ridiculous.
